title: Servo
description: Moves a servo device to the input position: an angle, a speed (continuous servo) or a byte, as the servo is set up.
activation: Runs every pass while enabled; commands the servo only when the value changes.

value.title: Value
value.description: The position: degrees for an angle servo, -100..100 for a continuous one, 0..255 when the servo steers by byte. Overrides the Value setting.

set.title: Set
set.description: On: the servo follows the value. Off: it does what When not active says. Unwired counts as on.
